fullDesc: Portugal beat host France 1-0 in the Euro 2016 final in Paris after extra time. Cristiano Ronaldo went off injured in the first half, and Eder scored the winner.
realFacts: It was Portugal's first major trophy
Ronaldo cheered his team from the touchline
Portugal won none of its group games in 90 minutes
Ronaldo is the all-time top international goalscorer
